faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Ananthapuramu District Court Computer Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Ananthapuramu District Court Computer Assistant recruitment is 27th October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Computer Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Computer Assistant post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 17,500/- per month. This is a contract position.

faq.question: Q3. What are the eligibility criteria for the Computer Assistant position?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates from a recognized university with knowledge in computer operations, basic software skills, and good hardware troubleshooting abilities. Familiarity with operating systems like Windows, Linux, and Ubuntu is also required.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 42 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Computer Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Computer Assistant post will primarily involve a Technical/Skill Test. Candidates will be evaluated based on their practical knowledge and skills.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Ananthapuramu District Court Computer Assistant recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it via post.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of necessary documents, including a photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates, along with the filled application form.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this Computer Assistant position?
faq.answer: The Computer Assistant position is a contract-based job. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure as specified in the appointment letter.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Ananthapuramu District Court. Links are provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.
